comment: The progressive approach is helpful, but aligning underlying data models directly to FHIR resource structures may create technology dependency and conflict with the stated role of technology-independent logical models.

public.text: The progressive approach is helpful, but aligning underlying data models directly to FHIR resource structures may create technology dependency and conflict with the stated role of technology-independent logical models.
public.suggestedRevision: Recommend alignment to governed logical concepts and mappings to FHIR, rather than requiring internal data structures to mirror FHIR resources.
